title: Create Your HylooSec Account
description: Follow this guide to create your HylooSec account and securely save the login details generated after registration.

blocks.text: HylooSec is designed to let users create a private identity without requiring them to publicly display their real personal information.

blocks.title: Choose Memorable Information
blocks.text: You may use a preferred name, nickname, profile identity, mood, or other memorable information. Make sure you can remember the information because some details may be needed for account recovery or verification.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Enter the name that you want to use on HylooSec. It may be your real name, nickname, display name, or any preferred identity.
fields.important: Choose a name that you can remember.

fields.name: Father Name
fields.description: Enter a memorable name in this field. HylooSec does not require you to publicly display your real father's name.
fields.important: Remember the value entered here because it may be used for account-related verification.

fields.name: Bio
fields.description: Write a short description about yourself, your current mood, your interests, or any profile message.
fields.important: Avoid adding sensitive personal information such as your address, phone number, financial details, or private identification numbers.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Select a memorable date for your HylooSec profile. A real date of birth is not required by the current registration process.
fields.important: Make sure the selected date follows any minimum-age requirements applicable to the service.

fields.name: Chat Security
fields.description: Choose how you want to protect access to your chats. Depending on the available option, you may create a security key or a PIN.

options.label: Generate Key
options.description: The system generates or accepts a security key for chat protection.

options.label: Create PIN
options.description: Create a memorable numeric PIN for accessing protected chat features.

fields.important: Do not share your chat security key or PIN with another person.

fields.name: Security Question
fields.description: Select a security question that can help verify your account during recovery or security checks.
fields.example: What is the name of your first school?
fields.important: Choose a question whose answer you can remember but other people cannot easily guess.

fields.name: Security Answer
fields.description: Enter the answer to your selected security question.
fields.important: Security answers may be case-sensitive. Remember the spelling and format you use.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Create a strong password for your HylooSec account.
recommendations: Use a long and unique password.
Do not reuse a password from another website.
Do not share your password with anyone.

fields.name: Confirm Password
fields.description: Enter the same password again to confirm that it was entered correctly.
fields.important: The Password and Confirm Password fields must match.

fields.name: User Privacy Checkbox
fields.description: Read and accept the Privacy Policy and related terms before creating your account.
fields.important: You cannot join HylooSec until the required privacy checkbox is selected.

items.title: Enter Your Name
items.description: Enter any preferred name or identity that you want to use on HylooSec.

items.title: Enter the Father Name
items.description: Enter a memorable value in the Father Name field.

items.title: Add Your Bio
items.description: Write a short profile description, interest, status, or mood.

items.title: Select a Date of Birth
items.description: Select a memorable date according to the registration requirements.

items.title: Choose Chat Security
items.description: Choose between a security key or PIN, depending on the options displayed on the registration page.

items.title: Select a Security Question
items.description: Choose a security question that will be easy for you to remember but difficult for others to guess.

items.title: Enter the Security Answer
items.description: Provide the correct answer for the selected security question.

items.title: Create Your Password
items.description: Enter a strong and unique password.

items.title: Confirm Your Password
items.description: Re-enter the same password in the Confirm Password field.

items.title: Accept the Privacy Policy
items.description: Read the Privacy Policy and select the confirmation checkbox.

items.title: Join HylooSec
items.description: Click the Join HylooSec button to submit the registration form.

items.solution: Complete every required field before submitting the registration form.
Enter the same password in both the Password and Confirm Password fields.
Create a stronger password that meets the password requirements displayed on the page.
Select a security question and enter its answer.
Read the Privacy Policy and select the required checkbox.
Check your internet connection and try again. Avoid repeatedly clicking the Join HylooSec button while the request is processing.

blocks.text: After the registration form is successfully submitted, HylooSec creates your account and opens a success page.

items.title: Account Creation Confirmation
items.description: A success message confirms that your HylooSec account has been created.

items.title: Receive Your User ID
items.description: HylooSec generates a unique User ID for your account. This User ID is required to sign in.

items.title: Review Your Login Details
items.description: The success page displays the account information required for login.

items.title: Download the Account Document
items.description: HylooSec provides a PDF document containing important account and login information.

items.title: Store the Document Safely
items.description: Save the downloaded document in a secure location that is not accessible to other people.

items.title: Continue to Login
items.description: Open the HylooSec login page and use your generated User ID and account password to sign in.

blocks.title: Important Account Document
blocks.text: The PDF generated after registration may contain information needed to access or recover your account. Treat it as confidential.

blocks.title: How to Protect the PDF
items: Do not send the PDF through public chats.
Do not upload it to an unknown website.
Do not share screenshots of the document.
Store it inside a password-protected folder or trusted password manager.
Keep a secure backup in case your device is lost.
Delete unnecessary copies from shared or public devices.

sections.title: Log In After Creating Your Account

items.title: Open the Login Page
items.description: Go to the HylooSec login page.

items.title: Enter Your User ID
items.description: Enter the unique User ID generated after registration.

items.title: Enter Your Password
items.description: Enter the password that you created during registration.

items.title: Submit the Login Form
items.description: Click the Login button to access your HylooSec account.

blocks.title: Keep Your User ID Safe
blocks.text: Your User ID is an important account identifier. Save it securely because it is required for future logins.

items: Avoid entering your phone number, home address, banking details, government identification number, or other sensitive information in your name or bio.
Use a password that is unique to HylooSec.
Never share your password, security answer, security key, or PIN.
Do not leave your account document on a public or shared computer.
Always verify that you are using the official HylooSec website before entering login details.
Log out after using HylooSec on a shared device.

blocks.title: Account Recovery
blocks.text: If you lose your User ID, password, security information, and downloaded account document, account recovery may become difficult or impossible. Keep the required account information securely stored.

popup.title: Create Account Help
content: Choose a memorable name, date and security answer.
Select your preferred chat security method.
Save your generated User ID and account document securely.
